name: GRIP1 associated protein 1
pathways: regulation of recycling endosome localization within postsynapse

function.text: GRIPAP1 encodes GRIP1-associated protein 1 [Cleaved into: GRASP-1 C-terminal chain]. Annotated molecular activities include guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and ionotropic glutamate receptor binding. It participates in negative regulation of receptor clustering and regulation of recycling endosome localization within postsynapse.
